skill.name: docusign-automation
skill.description: Automate DocuSign templates, envelopes, recipient roles, signature sending, and status checks through Rube MCP.
skill.summary: Guides DocuSign template, envelope, and signing-status workflows through Rube MCP.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most command-execution alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around MCP tool names, parameters, and examples. The skill still relies on the external Rube MCP endpoint and can send DocuSign envelopes, so explicit user confirmation and clear connection guidance are required.

remediation.issue: Third-party MCP endpoint and OAuth trust boundary
remediation.suggestion: Document that Rube MCP will broker DocuSign access, and advise users to verify scopes before authorizing the connection.
Require explicit user confirmation before creating an envelope with sent status or calling the send-envelope tool.

remediation.issue: Recipient data exposure through signing emails
remediation.suggestion: Validate recipient names, email addresses, subject lines, and message text with the user before sending any envelope.

static_findings.snippet: - Active DocuSign connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `docusign`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
- Response includes template `templateId`, `name`, `description`, roles, and fields
- `emailSubject`: Custom subject line for the signing email
- `emailBlurb`: Custom message in the signing email
- `templateRoles` must match the role names defined in the template exactly (case-sensitive)
- Setting `status` to 'sent' during creation sends immediately; use 'created' for drafts
- Each role requires at minimum `roleName`, `name`, and `email`
- `emailSubject` overrides the template's default email subject
1. `DOCUSIGN_GET_ENVELOPE` - Verify envelope exists and is in draft state [Prerequisite]
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- All required recipients must have valid email addresses before sending

content.value_statement: DocuSign envelope work often requires careful template selection, role mapping, and status tracking. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a structured Rube MCP workflow for those tasks.
actual_capabilities: Search current Rube MCP DocuSign tool schemas before running workflows.
List DocuSign templates and inspect template details, roles, and fields.
Create DocuSign envelopes from templates with mapped recipient roles.
Send draft envelopes and check envelope status through DocuSign tools.
Add templates to existing draft envelopes when DocuSign allows changes.
limitations: Requires an active Rube MCP connection and a DocuSign OAuth connection.
Cannot bypass DocuSign account permissions, recipient rules, or rate limits.
Does not provide direct DocuSign API code or stored credentials.
Works best with template-based DocuSign workflows, not custom document assembly.

use_cases.title: Prepare Sales Agreements
use_cases.description: Find the correct agreement template, map signer roles, create a draft envelope, and send it after review.

use_cases.title: Track Legal Signatures
use_cases.description: Check envelope status, review recipient progress, and identify documents that are delivered, signed, completed, declined, or voided.

use_cases.title: Manage Onboarding Forms
use_cases.description: Use approved DocuSign templates to prepare onboarding packets and monitor completion for each required signer.

prompt_templates.title: List Available Templates
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the DocuSign Rube MCP tools to search current schemas first. Then list available templates and summarize names, roles, and template IDs.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Draft Envelope
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the named template, inspect required roles, and create a draft envelope for these recipients. Do not send it yet.

prompt_templates.title: Send a Reviewed Envelope
prompt_templates.prompt: Verify this draft envelope status, recipients, subject, and message. Ask for final confirmation before sending it through DocuSign.

prompt_templates.title: Monitor Signing Progress
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this envelope status and recipient progress. Explain what action is needed for each signer without polling more often than necessary.

output_examples.input: List DocuSign templates for sales contracts.
output_examples.output: The response identifies matching templates, shows each template name, summarizes required roles, and notes which template needs more review.

output_examples.input: Create a draft envelope from the standard NDA template.
output_examples.output: The response confirms the selected template, maps each signer role to a recipient, and states that the envelope remains in draft status.
The response reports the envelope status, recipient-level progress, sent time, completion time if present, and the next recommended action.

best_practices: Search Rube MCP tool schemas before every workflow because tool parameters may change.
Create envelopes as drafts first, then confirm recipients and content before sending.
Resolve template and envelope IDs from DocuSign results instead of hardcoding them.
anti_patterns: Sending envelopes immediately without user confirmation.
Assuming template role names are flexible or case-insensitive.
Polling envelope status too frequently during signing workflows.

faq.question: Does this skill include DocuSign credentials?
faq.answer: No. It requires the user to connect DocuSign through Rube MCP and complete OAuth authorization.

faq.question: Can it send documents for signature?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents workflows for creating and sending DocuSign envelopes, so user confirmation is important before sending.

faq.question: Can it create envelopes without templates?
faq.answer: The documented workflows focus on template-based envelopes and adding templates to draft envelopes.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through the skill marketplace format.

faq.question: Why must tool schemas be searched first?
faq.answer: Rube MCP tool parameters can change. Searching first helps the assistant use current DocuSign tool schemas.

faq.question: What data should users review before sending?
faq.answer: Users should review template choice, signer names, email addresses, subject text, message text, and envelope status.
